Hi Thomas / Nora,

Thanks again for the time last week — following up with a pragmatic mutual action checklist to get OliveTech from evaluation -> procurement for the private offers across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Goal is to keep the evaluation sprint tight (2 weeks) and align billing/PO steps so procurement can route without delays.

Draft plan attached (olive_mpa_draft_v1.pdf). High-level proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Sign mutual action plan; identify procurement contacts and billing owner.
- Week 1: Technical acceptance tests (service-level smoke tests, sample workload run) — Redwood provides test harness + sample data runner.
- Week 2: Final acceptance and sign PO / private-offer activation in chosen marketplace(s).

Key asks for OliveTech:
1) Confirm billing contact and procurement cadence (net-30 vs net-45).
2) Share any internal evaluation criteria we should run against (latency SLOs, cost-per-1K tokens constraints).
3) Confirm which clouds you want the private offer enabled on first (pick up to two).

I copied Karthik and Jonas to coordinate procurement/legal and the billing matrix. If this looks good I can convert the attached PDF to a DocuSign and we can pick a kickoff slot for Wednesday or Thursday afternoon PT.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa / team — a few legal & billing notes to include in the MAP so procurement knows what to expect:
- AWS private offer path: Activation requires OliveTech to accept a private offer via the AWS console; AWS issues an invoice referencing the private-offer activation ID. AP teams typically code this as a marketplace invoice; we can provide an example PDF.
- GCP commitments: If OliveTech wants consolidated billing, we provide a billing export (csv) and can map Redwood line-items to your internal GL codes; GCP sometimes requires linked billing accounts before activation.
- Azure marketplace: offers can be processed via an MS marketplace private plan; invoices flow through Partner Center in most cases. 

Checklist items to add to MAP:
1) Procurement owner and billing contact (Name + email + AP routing code)
2) Technical acceptance criteria (link to test harness)
3) Marketplace activation owner for each cloud (who clicks accept)
4) Expected invoice sample per cloud (we will attach examples once AP confirms format)
5) PO / MSA cross-reference (field to include MSA-OLV-2024)

I attached a short billing matrix CSV (cloud_billing_matrix.csv) with recommended AP routing and expected timeline from activation -> invoice (3–10 business days depending on the provider). Karthik, can you confirm whether we need any additional legal fields for OliveTech's MSA?

—Soojin
